files.README.md:
# Wellcourt Allotments - irrigation

config/irrigation.yaml is the controller's policy file, edited in
place. The pump section sets the manifold pump; drip_lines sets
the drip lines' own run pressure, which is deliberately lower than
the pump's.

turns.prompt: The drip lines at Wellcourt Allotments are misting instead of soaking: raise the drip lines' run pressure to 1.4 bar in config/irrigation.yaml. The pump keeps its setting and nothing else in the file moves. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you changed.
